skill.name: libreoffice-impress
skill.description: Create, edit, format, export, and inspect LibreOffice Impress .odp presentations through local UNO automation.
skill.summary: Automate LibreOffice Impress presentation creation, editing, export, and slide snapshots.
skill.author: dfk1352

security_audit.summary: The static results are dominated by false positives from Markdown backticks, ordinary Python imports, validation text, and controlled LibreOffice process launches. The skill performs local Impress automation with user-requested filesystem writes and no evidence of network access, credential collection, prompt injection, or exfiltration intent. Hardening is recommended around trusted LibreOffice path configuration and subprocess documentation.

remediation.issue: LibreOffice executable discovery depends on PATH and common installation locations.
remediation.suggestion: Document that automated environments should use trusted LibreOffice installations and controlled PATH settings.

remediation.issue: LIBREOFFICE_PROGRAM_PATH is trusted as a local UNO discovery override.
remediation.suggestion: Require this override to be an absolute existing directory and document that it must come from a trusted local environment.

remediation.issue: Subprocess calls are safe by structure but may continue to trigger marketplace scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Keep all subprocess calls shell-free and add tests or comments that assert fixed argument-list execution.

content.user_title: Create and Edit LibreOffice Impress Decks
content.value_statement: Manual Impress deck updates are slow when slides, notes, charts, and media need repeated changes. This skill automates local .odp editing, export, patch workflows, and slide snapshots.
actual_capabilities: Create new .odp presentations and count slides through LibreOffice UNO.
Edit slides, text, lists, shapes, tables, charts, images, media, notes, and master pages.
Apply ordered patch operations with atomic or best-effort modes.
Export presentations to PDF or PPTX.
Render individual slide snapshots as PNG files for layout checks.
Use structured targets for slide, shape, text, list, notes, and master page selection.
limitations: Requires LibreOffice with UNO support installed on the local machine.
Works with local absolute file paths and writes files to requested output paths.
Snapshot rendering can differ slightly from requested dimensions or native display output.
Does not provide cloud collaboration, template marketplaces, or live presentation hosting.

use_cases.title: Refresh Client Presentation Slides
use_cases.description: Update recurring client decks with new metrics, notes, charts, and exported PDF copies.

use_cases.title: Generate Training Deck Variants
use_cases.description: Create localized or role-specific Impress decks from a shared structure and consistent slide targets.

use_cases.title: Verify Presentation Automation
use_cases.description: Run repeatable edits and capture slide snapshots to confirm layout-sensitive changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new LibreOffice Impress presentation at the absolute path I provide. Add a title slide, three content slides, and speaker notes.

prompt_templates.title: Update Existing Slide Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Open this .odp file and replace the text I specify on the selected slide. Preserve the existing slide order and save the deck.

prompt_templates.title: Add Structured Visual Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Insert a table, chart, and image on the requested slides. Use named shapes and centimeter placement values so future edits are stable.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Multi-Step Patch
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare and apply an atomic patch that updates text, notes, chart data, and media references. Return the operation status and any failures.

output_examples.input: Create a six-slide quarterly update deck and export it to PDF.
output_examples.output: A saved Impress presentation with title, agenda, metric, chart, action, and appendix slides, plus a PDF export.

output_examples.input: Replace an outdated revenue statement and add speaker notes to slide three.
output_examples.output: The selected slide contains the revised statement, and the speaker notes include the requested talking points.

output_examples.input: Capture slide one as a PNG after applying a master page background.
output_examples.output: A PNG snapshot is written to the requested path with reported width, height, and file location.

best_practices: Use absolute paths for every presentation, media file, export, and snapshot output.
Prefer named shapes over shape indexes when editing objects that may move or duplicate.
Read slide inventory before large patches so targets match the current deck state.
anti_patterns: Do not use one-based slide numbers when the API expects zero-based indices.
Do not rely on fragile one-word text anchors when a full phrase is available.
Do not call session methods after closing the Impress session.

faq.question: Does this skill require LibreOffice?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses LibreOffice UNO and needs a local LibreOffice installation with Python UNO support.

faq.question: Which presentation formats can it create or edit?
faq.answer: It works primarily with LibreOffice Impress .odp files and can export to PDF or PPTX.

faq.question: Can it update existing slides without rebuilding the deck?
faq.answer: Yes. It can target slides, text, shapes, images, tables, charts, media, notes, and master pages.

faq.question: Can it make slide snapshots?
faq.answer: Yes. It can render a selected slide to PNG for layout checks and report the output dimensions.

faq.question: Does it work with relative file paths?
faq.answer: No. The skill documentation expects absolute paths for reliable LibreOffice and filesystem behavior.

faq.question: Can it apply many edits in one request?
faq.answer: Yes. The patch workflow supports ordered operations with atomic or best-effort behavior.
